column1: # THE CONDITIONAL RATE ROWS (2026-09-30): the short rate where a refuge holds cash -- the two years
# after each 20% decline's trough (`rate_after_readings` / `rateAfterReadings`): the union of the
# 504 sessions after every trough of a 20%+ decline of the set's equity record, read on the daily
# effective federal funds rate (FRED DFF) over those sessions.
# post-trough rate %          the rate's mean over those sessions, percent
# post-trough floor share %   the share of them under 0.50%, percent
# The bands are the record's own: moving one-year-block resamples of the PAIRED series (the returns
# and the rates cut from the same block starts, so a resample keeps each decline beside its rates),
# 20000 resamples, seed 20260918; the joint band over the two rows at 2/18 of the set's 0.10 (the
# sets' other 16 banded rows keep their 2026-09-26 bands, which were split over 16).
# Sources, public: QQQ adjusted closes from Yahoo's chart API (1999-03-10..2026-08-20); CRSP from
# Ken French's F-F_Research_Data_Factors_daily (Mkt-RF + RF, 1954-01-04..2026-06-30); DFF from
# FRED (fredgraph.csv?id=DFF). A session without a rate on its date is dropped.
#   record_bands -set nasdaq -series QQQ -yahoo <data>/QQQ.csv -fred <data>/DFF.csv -rateafter
#   record_bands -set sp500 -series CRSP -french <data>/F-F_Research_Data_Factors_daily.csv
#       -fred <data>/DFF.csv -rateafter -from 1954-01-04 -to 2026-06-30 -of 18
